subject: The findings-and-sessions architecture disagrees with itself and with the tree
recordedOccasion: on the owner's request to review the new architecture.
severity: one finding is high and governs a rule every future session hits on its first parked note. The rest are small and mechanical.
scope: cross-cutting. The fix lands in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `docs/INDEX.md`, `docs/sessions/INDEX.md`, `docs/legend.md` and four `prompt.md` files — no single runbook owns any of it.

findings.statement: §4b and §4c contradict each other on whether a findings bundle takes a manifest revision
findings.sectionHeading: F1 — §4b and §4c contradict each other, eighteen lines apart

resolution.whatWasDone: The contradiction has no surface left: `copilot-instructions.md` carries no §4b or §4c, and §7 states “Every change of any kind takes a revision”

findings.statement: Four of five `prompt.md` files violate §4d's "always" rule
findings.sectionHeading: F2 — four of five prompts omit the reading §4d makes mandatory

resolution.whatWasDone: §5 states the rule the deleted §4d carried: every `prompt.md` names the instruction set before anything else, binding prompts written from now

findings.statement: `docs/sessions/INDEX.md` miscounts a manifest it links to
findings.sectionHeading: F3 — an index and the manifest it links to disagree

resolution.whatWasDone: All seven rows of `docs/sessions/INDEX.md` agree with the manifests they link to, verified row by row 2026-09-09

findings.statement: `docs/INDEX.md` says `ideas/` is empty; it is not
findings.sectionHeading: F4 — `docs/INDEX.md` describes a directory it no longer matches

resolution.whatWasDone: §3 carries the migrated-bundle carve-out again, and says so

findings.sectionHeading: F6 — the two state diagrams disagree

resolution.whatWasDone: One session-state diagram, in `docs/legend.md`; `findings-and-sessions.md` no longer draws one

findings.statement: Two session identifiers recorded as unrecoverable are recoverable
findings.sectionHeading: F7 — two identifiers recorded as unrecoverable are recoverable

resolution.whatWasDone: §5 requires any `not recoverable` to name the searches that came back empty

decisions.decision: The required-reading rule survives its home being deleted: restated in `.github/session-management-instructions.md`, binding every `prompt.md` written from now. Existing prompts are evidence and are not rewritten
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — the required-reading rule survives, forward only

decisions.decision: The migrated-bundle carve-out is restored: a bundle migrated from an already-closed record carries `resolutions.md` and no `decisions.md`, and says so. One decision answers this bundle's F5 and `0047` F4
decisions.sectionHeading: D2 — the carve-out is restored, and it answers two bundles

decisions.decision: F1, F3, F4, F6 and F7 were resolved in `0027`, regressed by `1c48deb`, and hold again against the files that replaced it; each is resolved against where its rule now lives and the regression is named
decisions.sectionHeading: D3 — resolved once, regressed, and resolved again

contributions.date: no reading order; buried in a ground-rules bullet (`prompt.md:33`)
cited only as *why the file exists*; `prompt.md:13` sends the reader to `restore-git.md` first

edges.why: whether eleven bundles resolved before the shape existed owe a decisions.md depends on what the architecture says a bundle must hold
the same reading in two bundles; D2 answers both
